It is a hybrid volume rendering technique that leverages the GPU's depth buffer to skip empty spaces, allowing ray casting to sample only non-transparent material [S1].

The evidence explicitly describes a hybrid volume rendering technique by Westermann & Sevenich that uses OpenGL's alpha test and depth test (leveraging the depth buffer) to determine the near and far intersection points of rays with the volume. This process allows the algorithm to skip empty spaces and perform ray casting only between these points, effectively sampling only non-transparent (significant) material.
